answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-weighted quadratic voting on a shared trellis of identity bonds. Voting weight grows only with the square root of locked stake, so splitting one purse into many fake names gains nothing. A raven watchdog slashes any agent caught signing conflicting ballots, burning its bond. To seize the zenith of control, an attacker must lock real capital and risk forfeiture, making a fake army cost far more than honest play.
